Every bug of the CHIM engine: its streaming and memory, world format, builder, stairs and collision on CHIM worlds, rendering and performance. Generated together with the [bug register](../BUGS.md) from [`bugs.json`](bugs.json); a test fails when this page is stale or a CHIM bug is missing. Which bugs appear here and how to add one: [CHIM bugs](README.md#chim-bugs). Design: [world streamer](../WORLD_STREAMER.md).

### Persisting, not resolved

Bugs reported two or more times. Most reports first. Each has its report lines on its page.

- [BUILD-CHIM-STAGE-SERIAL-TAIL-36](BUILD-CHIM-STAGE-SERIAL-TAIL-36.md): After the parallel world build the chim stage ran its validation, heap gate and zone walk on one core (about 10 minutes of the 270-frame coast build) (reported 13 times, open)
- [BUILD-CHIM-CELLS-PRIVATE-LIST-47](BUILD-CHIM-CELLS-PRIVATE-LIST-47.md): The releases' CHIM cell list was not in the source tree; public builds had no CHIM exterior cells (reported 11 times, fixed)
- [CHIM-AZURA-FLOATING-FLORA-43](CHIM-AZURA-FLOATING-FLORA-43.md): Plant or tree pieces hang in the air at Azura's Coast (cell 16,7) (reported 7 times, open)
- [BUILD-PIPELINE-UNDERUTILIZATION-36](BUILD-PIPELINE-UNDERUTILIZATION-36.md): Umbrella: several builder phases run on one core while the rest of the machine idles, and some do work the build no longer needs (reported 5 times, open)
- [BUILD-STATS-SERIAL-36](BUILD-STATS-SERIAL-36.md): The CHIM stats step runs serially and silently on one core (reported 5 times, fixed)
- [BUILD-CHIM-SERIAL-SECTIONS-44](BUILD-CHIM-SERIAL-SECTIONS-44.md): The CHIM stage runs several sections on one core while units wait: visibility rows starve their workers (reported 4 times, open)
- [BUILD-CHIM-STAIR-WALK-UNCACHED-36](BUILD-CHIM-STAIR-WALK-UNCACHED-36.md): CHIM frames are stair-walked again on every build: about 69 minutes for 270 frames (reported 4 times, fixed)
- [BUILD-IMAGE-CHIM-MAPS-SERIAL-36](BUILD-IMAGE-CHIM-MAPS-SERIAL-36.md): The image step writes the CHIM region cells' .chim maps one by one on half a core, silently (reported 4 times, fixed)
- [BUILD-OPTIMIZER-CACHE-KEY-BROAD-36](BUILD-OPTIMIZER-CACHE-KEY-BROAD-36.md): Regression: the image step's BSP optimizer pass cache reused 13 of 2,658 maps; its key covers the whole image tool, so any image-code change redoes every map (reported 4 times, fixed)
- [BUILD-PROFILER-NO-WASTE-ALARM-36](BUILD-PROFILER-NO-WASTE-ALARM-36.md): No profiler, perf ledger or gate flagged idle cores, work done for maps that are removed, or growth of the image (reported 4 times, fixed)
- [CHIM-BALMORA-INSET-SLIVERS-43](CHIM-BALMORA-INSET-SLIVERS-43.md): Balmora's town frame hands over 96 units inside its cells: the 8 cells around the town keep classic strips, built as 15 legacy maps (11.5 MB) with every object of those cells (reported 4 times, fixed)
- [CHIM-FRAME-EDGE-EFRAG-CRASH-36](CHIM-FRAME-EDGE-EFRAG-CRASH-36.md): R_StoreEfrags: Bad entity type 270440 ends the game: a leaf link to an entity whose model is NULL (normal play in Seyda Neen; noclip past the Vivec frame edge) (reported 4 times, fixed)
- [BUILD-CHIM-FRAME-SWAP-LATE-36](BUILD-CHIM-FRAME-SWAP-LATE-36.md): The image step builds 335 legacy maps of cells already on CHIM, then removes them before packing (reported 3 times, fixed)
- [BUILD-IMAGE-AUDIO-SERIAL-36](BUILD-IMAGE-AUDIO-SERIAL-36.md): The image step puts the audio payload in one file at a time while 22 of 24 cores sit idle (reported 3 times, fixed)
- [BUILD-LEGACY-TOWN-MAPS-SHIPPED-36](BUILD-LEGACY-TOWN-MAPS-SHIPPED-36.md): CHIM-native Seyda Neen is still built through the legacy chain: 65 sn maps are built and removed before packing (build time, not payload) (reported 3 times, fixed)
- [BUILD-PARTITION-GROWTH-UNGATED-36](BUILD-PARTITION-GROWTH-UNGATED-36.md): Nothing gates the number of world partitions or the growth of the image (reported 3 times, open)
- [BUILD-STAGE-READS-UNFINGERPRINTED-48](BUILD-STAGE-READS-UNFINGERPRINTED-48.md): Two stages read repository files their fingerprint leaves out, so their records are refused and they rerun on every reuse (reported 3 times, fixed)
- [CHIM-CROSSING-SLUGGISH-43](CHIM-CROSSING-SLUGGISH-43.md): Crossing between CHIM cells is sluggish, worst at cell corners (reported 3 times, open)
- [CHIM-DAGOTH-UR-RUIN-CYLINDER-44](CHIM-DAGOTH-UR-RUIN-CYLINDER-44.md): Graphics translation glitch at Dagoth Ur: the blight cloud whirlwind (nested translucent cylinders) is drawn solid and still (reported 3 times, open)
- [CHIM-EXTERIOR-ACTORS-MISSING-46](CHIM-EXTERIOR-ACTORS-MISSING-46.md): Most outdoor NPCs and every outdoor creature are missing: region frames place no actors (93 of 566 exterior NPC references, 0 of 5,415 creature references) (reported 3 times, open)
- [CHIM-READ-RUNS-33](CHIM-READ-RUNS-33.md): CHIM crossings read little but in many separate runs, so FFS seeks dominate (reported 3 times, open)
- [CHIM-RED-MOUNTAIN-SOLID-SKY-43](CHIM-RED-MOUNTAIN-SOLID-SKY-43.md): On the Red Mountain summit (cell 2,9) the player ends up inside solid and only the sky is drawn, no terrain (reported 3 times, open)
- [CHIM-ROCKS-OPEN-SHELLS-43](CHIM-ROCKS-OPEN-SHELLS-43.md): Several rock meshes on CHIM do not close up: open faces where the rock should be solid (reported 3 times, open)
- [CHIM-SEYDA-BALMORA-LOAD-HANG-43](CHIM-SEYDA-BALMORA-LOAD-HANG-43.md): Travelling from Seyda Neen to Balmora sometimes hangs on the Loading screen (boot smoke, 2 of about 5 runs) (reported 3 times, open)
- [CHIM-TILT-VARIANTS-SPLIT-33](CHIM-TILT-VARIANTS-SPLIT-33.md): Tilted placements each get their own model variant: 39,103 extra model variants on the base island, breaking store-once (reported 3 times, open)
- [CHIM-VIVEC-DOCK-WALKWAY-43](CHIM-VIVEC-DOCK-WALKWAY-43.md): The player cannot climb the walkway at the Vivec Hlaalu canton dock and gets stuck (reported 3 times, open)
- [CHIM-ZONE-RELEASE-FLICKER-42](CHIM-ZONE-RELEASE-FLICKER-42.md): Full CHIM zone: distant buildings pop in and out while standing still, and the retry costs frames (reported 3 times, open)
- [STAIRS-EBONHEART-CHIM-36](STAIRS-EBONHEART-CHIM-36.md): Three Ebonheart flights fail the CHIM stair gate in the whole-city Vivec frame (reported 3 times, fixed)
- [VIVEC-TEMPLE-STAIRS-33](VIVEC-TEMPLE-STAIRS-33.md): Palace steps and High Fane quarter flights fail the stair gate on the CHIM Vivec Temple frame (reported 3 times, fixed)
- [BUILD-CHIM-MAIN-MEMORY-46](BUILD-CHIM-MAIN-MEMORY-46.md): The CHIM stage main process holds so much memory that the memory guard starves its own workers (reported 2 times, open)
- [BUILD-CHIM-STAGE-IDLE-START-36](BUILD-CHIM-STAGE-IDLE-START-36.md): The chim stage of the 270-frame coast build spends its first 35-45 minutes on 1-4 cores while it holds 12-24 workers (reported 2 times, open)
- [BUILD-IMAGE-CHIM-NATIVE-TOWN-36](BUILD-IMAGE-CHIM-NATIVE-TOWN-36.md): The image step of a CHIM-native town read legacy region maps that are never built: the Bitter Coast test build failed at the end of its image step on maps/bc000.bsp (reported 2 times, fixed)
- [BUILD-IMAGE-REGION-MAPS-SERIAL-43](BUILD-IMAGE-REGION-MAPS-SERIAL-43.md): The image step's CHIM frame-map phases run on one core: the world read six times, ground traces on whole frames (reported 2 times, open)
- [BUILD-LEGACY-CHAIN-DEFAULT-36](BUILD-LEGACY-CHAIN-DEFAULT-36.md): Builds still prepared CHIM towns through the legacy region-map chain by default, and a retired flag (--legacy-area) was accepted with only a warning (reported 2 times, fixed)
- [BUILD-PLAN-PESSIMISTIC-48](BUILD-PLAN-PESSIMISTIC-48.md): The start-up resource plan predicts hours for stages that run in minutes: it sums every stage that could run beside one at full speed (reported 2 times, open)
- [BUILD-PROGRESS-ETA-BASIS-36](BUILD-PROGRESS-ETA-BASIS-36.md): The live build progress took a stage's expected time from earlier runs of any size: dev3's chim stage was expected at 154 s and ran 1 h 48 min (reported 2 times, open)
- [BUILD-SILENT-PHASES-36](BUILD-SILENT-PHASES-36.md): Builder phases run silent: no start/end timing, no progress, no heartbeat; the CHIM stats step is a single-core tail (reported 2 times, open)
- [BUILD-STAIR-WALK-BRUTE-FORCE-46](BUILD-STAIR-WALK-BRUTE-FORCE-46.md): The builder walks every step of the island to find out whether its own collision can be walked, an answer the game data already holds (reported 2 times, open)
- [CHIM-LEGACY-CHAIN-33](CHIM-LEGACY-CHAIN-33.md): CHIM builds still run the legacy exterior chain: frame maps read the legacy region maps, and the open world is built (reported 2 times, closed)
- [CHIM-MESHLESS-LIGHTS-33](CHIM-MESHLESS-LIGHTS-33.md): Exterior lights without a mesh have no CHIM light path: 2,284 placed lights give no light in a CHIM frame (reported 2 times, open)
- [CHIM-ROOM-HEART-CHAMBER-LOAD-50](CHIM-ROOM-HEART-CHAMBER-LOAD-50.md): Entering Akulakhan s Chamber (the Heart Chamber) ends the game: a model of its room store does not load, and the engine stops with Host_Error instead of refusing at the door (reported 2 times, open)
- [CHIM-TERRAIN-TEXTURE-BLOCKY-43](CHIM-TERRAIN-TEXTURE-BLOCKY-43.md): Roads and paths on the ground look blocky: each texture square is drawn with hard edges instead of blending into its neighbours (reported 2 times, open)
- [CHIM-ZONE-BUDGET-33](CHIM-ZONE-BUDGET-33.md): The engine's default CHIM zone does not hold the active ring of Seyda Neen or of Balmora's south-west corner (reported 2 times, fixed)
- [CREATURE-DAGOTH-UR-ABSENT-52](CREATURE-DAGOTH-UR-ABSENT-52.md): Dagoth Ur and the Heart of Lorkhan are not in their rooms: the room creature list never named them, so Akulakhan s Chamber has neither (reported 2 times, open)
- [IMAGE-ONE-HDF-TARGET-36](IMAGE-ONE-HDF-TARGET-36.md): The game ships on two drive images and three world partitions; the project target is the whole game on one HDF (reported 2 times, fixed)
- [INTERIOR-CREATURES-MISSING-41](INTERIOR-CREATURES-MISSING-41.md): No creature is placed in any interior: the resident stage takes NPC records only, so the demigod Vivec is missing from his palace (reported 2 times, open)
